title: 第十章 【工藤新一不是这样的！】
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

毛利小五郎的算盘珠子打的太响，小兰没给他留下好脸色，头也不回的走了。

只是走远了些，小兰忍不住问工藤新一：“新一，最后你和爸爸说了什么？为什么你捡到爸爸的钱包，爸爸就同意我们…同意我搬走了？”

工藤新一有点为难的开口：“这个嘛……按照江湖规矩，既然你爸爸已经退让了，我该给他保守秘密的。”

又亮起了一盏绿灯。

“但既然是小兰你问了，那我当然是实话实说了。”

“那个叫玫瑰苑的地方是一个夜总会。我在来你家的路上捡到了你爸爸的钱包，里面还有玫瑰苑的账单。既然账单在他的手里，多半结账的人就是你爸爸而非所谓的委托人。”

绿灯、绿灯、绿灯。

“而且从账单上点酒的数量来说，一共应该有四或五个人，除了酒以外，账单上还有五个……陪酒聊天服务。”

小兰懂了，老爸昨天下午并不是见委托人，而是叫上了三四个酒友，在一家夜总会搂着陪酒女花天酒地。

一团阴云在小兰的头顶聚集，一场专属于毛利小五郎的暴风雨正在酝酿。

而且老爸居然为了不让自己知道这件事，宁可同意自己搬出去。

但小兰还有一件事不明白：“既然他们点了五个……陪酒聊天服务，为什么新一你要说‘四或五个人’啊？”

不应该就是五个人吗？

工藤新一耸耸肩：“因为有一种潜规则叫做：请客的人可以点两个。”

小兰的脸逐渐被阴影遮盖，暴风雨要来的更猛烈了。

自己搬出来是对的！那个臭老头，就不值得管！

毛利兰忽然用质疑的目光看向工藤新一：“说起来，新一怎么知道那种潜规则的？”

这家伙将来不会也变成那样吧？

工藤新一得意的仰头：“这就是一个名侦探的博闻强识了。”

【滴——！】一盏醒目的红灯出现在视线里，这句话被系统判断为谎言了，一旦接下来的九句话再出现谎言，隐藏挑战任务就失败了。

——————

东京的另一边，走在上班路上的渚琰·剑勇正人停下脚步，唤出了系统：“喂！这怎么就是撒谎了？难道我不是名侦探？”

【不，工藤新一已经可以勉强称作名侦探，当玩家扮演工藤新一时，确实是名侦探。谎言的判断依据是：玩家尚不够博闻强识。】

Page (1/3)

Mouri Kogoro's abacus beads were playing too loudly, and Xiaolan didn't leave him with a good look, so she left without looking back.

Just walking a little further, Xiaolan couldn't help but ask Kudo Shinichi: "Shinichi, what did you say to your father in the end? Why did your father agree to let us... agree to me moving away when you found his wallet?"

Kudo Shinichi said a little embarrassed: "Well...according to the rules of the world, since your father has given in, I should keep his secret."

Another green light came on.

"But since it's Xiaolan who's asking, of course I'm telling the truth."

"The place called Rose Garden is a nightclub. I picked up your father's wallet on the way to your house, and there was a bill from Rose Garden in it. Since the bill is in his hand, most likely the person who paid the bill is your father and not the so-called client."

Green light, green light, green light.

"And judging from the number of drinks ordered on the bill, there should be four or five people in total. In addition to the drinks, there are five... wine and chat services on the bill."

Xiaolan understood that her father did not meet the client yesterday afternoon. Instead, he called three or four drinking buddies and had a great time in a nightclub with the bartender in his arms.

A dark cloud gathered above Xiaolan's head, and a storm dedicated to Mouri Kogoro was brewing.

Moreover, my father actually agreed to move out by himself in order not to let him know about it.

But there's one thing Xiaolan doesn't understand: "Since they ordered five... wine and chat service, why did Shinichi say 'four or five people'?"

Shouldn't it be just five people?

Kudo Shinichi shrugged: "Because there is an unspoken rule: the person who treats you can order two."

Xiaolan's face was gradually covered by shadows, and the storm was coming more violently.

It was right to move out on your own!That stinky old man is not worth taking care of!

Mao Lilan suddenly looked at Kudo Shinichi with questioning eyes: "Speaking of which, how does Shinichi know that unspoken rule?"

Will this guy become like that in the future?

Kudo Shinichi raised his head proudly: "This is the profound knowledge of a famous detective."
